limitations: Counts are table-row observations, field-row cells and exact native-reference observations, not unique people, companies, credentials, access or confirmed exposures.

Each metric retains its own source-row denominator. Overlapping fields and exports must not be summed as people; primary and independent passes are verification repeats. Bridge rereads add zero coverage.

Country counts use exact saved literals, not residence, Hong Kong legal identity, employment, ownership or current relationships. Email shape is lexical only, not identity, deliverability or uniqueness.
Text-body shape and lengths establish no content meaning or confidentiality. No audio, linked files, attachments or URLs were accessed.
Chorus REL18/REL20 are cross-era candidate comparisons; discontinued and current records do not prove continuity or deduplication.

Workforce fields and saved lifecycle flags do not establish employment, deletion, residence, ownership or inferred salary. Ancillary financial or salary-named fields provide presence/context only; no values or sums are exported.

Only contracted top-level fields and candidate native references are counted. Unknown field names and values, embedded parsing, fuzzy joins and code-enumeration meanings are excluded. Unresolved references are packet-relative.
Both passes share the parser, decompressor/runtime, SQLite, namespace planner, validation and advisory-lock coordination. Independent reducers are not independent decoders.
Selected stream CRC/EOF, exact compressed/decoded sizes and hashes are verified by the paired runner; full outer SHA256 and EOF remain inherited, not freshly checked by this assembler.

Resources are sampled with structural storage bounds, not kernel quotas. Cooperating writers, runtime/OS closure, native overshoot, live-orphan risk and fail-closed postcommit loss remain limitations.

Assembly adds no source scan or coverage and admits no findings. Independent actual review, parent scope admission and public release require later separate manifests. Cost work remains stopped and automation paused.
